spec.description: A Ripple spec is a JSON object with two top-level fields that matter for rendering: `ui` (the node tree the renderer mounts — REQUIRED) and `state` (the StateManager seed — required when any node uses `bind` or reads `{state.*}`). The renderable tree field is named `ui` exactly — never `root`, `tree`, `view`, `body`, or `content`. Specs that use those aliases will not render.

set.description: Assign `value` to the state path `target`. The most common action — use it to update any state field.

shape.value?: any — value to assign. Supports {state.x} expressions.

toggle.description: Flip a boolean target, or toggle membership of `value` in an array target.

shape.target: string — state path. If boolean, value is inverted; if array, `value` is added or removed.
shape.value?: any — when target is an array, the membership toggle key.

push.description: Append `value` to the array at `target`. Creates the array if undefined.

shape.target: string — state path to an array.

remove.description: Remove an item from the array at `target` — by `value` (equality match) or by `index`.

shape.target: string — state path to an array.
shape.value?: any — first matching item is removed.

open.description: Set the target state path to `true`. Idiomatic shortcut for opening a modal or dialog whose `value` is bound to that path.

shape.target: string — state path that controls the modal/dialog open state.

navigate.description: Host-delegated URL change. The host's `onEvent` callback performs the navigation.

toast.description: Show a toast notification. Use after `set` / `api` to give the user feedback.

emit.description: Emit a custom event up to the host. Use to hand control back to the host pipeline (e.g. "submit complete, take it from here").

pin.description: Host-delegated bookmark/pin operation. The host implements the persistence.

shape.value?: any — payload describing the pinned item.

api.description: Host-delegated HTTP call. The host performs the request; the response is written to `response_key` (if given) and `on_success` runs. On failure `on_error` runs and the error is exposed at state path `_flow_error`.

shape.body?: object — request body. Values support {state.x} expressions.
shape.response_key?: string — state path to write the response into.
shape.on_success?: EventHandler[] — runs after a successful response.

flow.description: Run a list of handlers sequentially. If any step throws `FlowAbortError` (e.g. failed `validate`), `on_error` runs.

branch.description: Evaluate `if` and run `then` or `else`. The condition is a Ripple expression string (e.g. "state.count > 5").

shape.if: string — Ripple expression evaluated as boolean.

confirm.description: Show the ConfirmDialog, suspend the flow, and run `on_confirm` or `on_cancel` based on the user's choice.

shape.message: string — body shown in the dialog.

validate.description: If `condition` is falsy, show a toast and abort the enclosing flow (FlowAbortError). Silent on pass.

shape.condition: string — Ripple expression. Falsy aborts the flow.

delay.description: Pause the flow for the given number of milliseconds. Useful for optimistic-UI demos and animations.

invoke.description: Call a registered widget method by widget id. Used for imperative actions on widgets that expose them (e.g. focusing an input).
